post.summary: Submit a turn
post.description: The caller's user ID comes from the bearer token. Use a unique turnId for each turn; repeating a successful turnId returns duplicate=true. The current score is a placeholder of 5 points per placement.

post.summary: Preview a line's legality and score (proposed)
post.description: PROPOSED CONTRACT ONLY; this route is not implemented. Mirrors Polkabow's GameSessionController.pending_score_preview, LineValidator.validate and ScoringCoordinator.preview_line. The authenticated caller must be a game member and the active player awaiting an action. The server resolves tile IDs from that player's held deck and evaluates the entire proposed line against one consistent stored match snapshot and its scoring rules. Request order does not affect the result. No board, deck, score ledger, scored-hand set, history, turn, achievement, or game version is changed; no tiles are drawn and no AI action is triggered. Repeated previews have no side effects and need no turnId. A preview reserves nothing; any later commit must independently revalidate the placements and version. The existing submitTurn route still uses placeholder scoring and does not yet accept rotations, so parity with that route is an implementation prerequisite, not a current guarantee.
x-implementation-prerequisites: Port or reuse Polkabow's line validation and scoring rules, including previously scored hands, boundaries and cluster entitlements; do not use the current five-points-per-placement placeholder.

Establish validated match state containing the board, held decks, caller-to-player mapping, action phase and versioned scoring configuration. Current create/update routes accept arbitrary client state, which is not a trusted rules authority. Missing or invalid state must produce GAME_STATE_UNAVAILABLE, never a fabricated zero score.
Before enabling server-authoritative gameplay, align commit validation, rotation handling, state ownership and version updates with preview. API gameVersion is not Polkabow's board revision.

200.description: Legal line evaluated without committing it. All points are hypothetical increments, not the player's cumulative score. Zero points can be a valid result.

openingPair.summary: Two Jacks of different face colors with no matching touching edge
openingPair.description: Assumes an empty board and these tiles in the caller's deck. Pair category 2 plus card values 1 + 1, with card and new-edge factors both 1, gives 4 poker points. No edge or cluster award.

409.description: After authentication and membership checks: reject a stale expectedVersion first, then an ended match, unavailable or invalid match state, unsupported scoring rules, or a caller who is not the active player awaiting an action. Missing games and non-members both receive 404. No state changes occur.

422.description: Well-formed request fails tile ownership or line legality. No partial score is returned. Unknown, unheld or repeated tile IDs produce TILE_NOT_AVAILABLE. Duplicate target cells produce CELL_OCCUPIED. Bounds, rotation and array-size violations are request validation errors (400).

post.summary: Pass when no legal move is available
post.description: The current player submits this after determining that no legal move is available. The API records the pass, advances to the other player in a two player game, and returns notification text for the client to display.

x-proposed-human-vs-ai-support.status: proposed; existing request and response schemas still describe the deployed two-account route
requirements: Use a validated human-versus-AI match with the authenticated account mapped to human and an internal AI actor, never a fabricated user account or a caller-supplied actor ID.

The server must verify that the human has no legal line and cannot perform the full-deck swap that Polkabow's automatic-pass flow prefers when supply permits. Both players lacking legal moves ends the match under existing rules instead of passing.

Accept the existing turnId/expectedVersion payload, record a zero-point pass atomically, advance to the AI and increment the API version. Deduplicate successful requests before checking version/phase, but always after membership checks.
Make currentPlayerId nullable for the internal AI turn and add an explicit human/ai active-actor field in a subsequent approved schema revision. The existing non-null UUID response is not sufficient.

Server-controlled AI turns must use the same legality/scoring rules and their own actor attribution. The current Polkabow client mirrors AI results through PATCH state and must not submit them as authenticated human turns.

post.summary: Swap held tiles (proposed)
post.description: PROPOSED; not implemented. Maps GameSessionController.request_swap and GameSessionState.request_swap. The authenticated human can swap one or more distinct tiles from their own deck instead of placing a line. The pot must supply the complete replacement before returned tiles re-enter it, so a returned tile cannot be immediately redrawn. Swaps award no points and end the turn. Validate ownership, turn phase and supply, then atomically update deck, pot, turn, state and API version once. The server schedules any AI action using its own actor identity; the client cannot claim to be AI. Retry of the same successful turnId and tile set by the same caller in the same game returns the original result with duplicate=true before version/phase checks; changed content returns ACTION_ID_CONFLICT. IDs share the game's turn/pass action namespace.

200.description: Swap accepted, or replay of the original successful result. gameVersion is the version immediately after this swap; subsequent AI actions may advance it further.

409.description: Stale version, ended match, wrong action phase, unavailable validated state, or reuse of an action ID with different content. No mutation on failure.

422.description: Tile not held or replacement supply insufficient.

post.summary: Resign a human-versus-AI match (proposed)
post.description: PROPOSED GAMEPLAY DECISION FOR REVIEW; Polkabow currently has no resignation rule or UI. The authenticated human member may concede an active human-versus-AI game, including during the AI turn. Proposed outcome: the AI wins regardless of score; existing scores are retained and no scoring or achievement bonus is granted. Atomically cancel pending AI work, mark the game completed with endReason=resigned and winner=ai, clear the active player, set completed_at and increment the API version once. A later AI result must not commit after resignation. This is not DELETE /games/{gameId}: game history is retained. Replay of the same successful actionId for the same caller/game returns the original result with duplicate=true before stale-version/finished checks; different content returns ACTION_ID_CONFLICT. Authentication and membership are always checked first.

200.description: Resignation recorded, or original successful result replayed.

409.description: Stale version, ended match, wrong action phase, unavailable validated state, or reuse of an action ID with different content. No mutation on failure.

PreviewTurnRequest.description: Only placement intent is accepted; board, tile faces/edges/suits, score, rules and player identity come from validated stored match state and authentication. The merged line must be gapless in one row or column, with two to five total cells including existing tiles. The opening requires at least two new tiles and must cover (5,5), (6,5), (5,6) or (6,6). Later moves must touch a committed tile orthogonally; one new tile can extend an existing hand. All affected runs must satisfy Polkabow's current hand legality, including perpendicular runs, and no run may exceed five cells. Matching edge colors are not required for legality.

expectedVersion.description: Required stored API game version. A mismatch returns 409 STALE_GAME_STATE. This is not the board revision.

tileId.description: Unique tile ID held in the caller's deck; must appear only once in the request.

rotation.description: Absolute clockwise quarter-turn index from the tile's unrotated edges: 0, 90, 180 or 270 degrees respectively. Not a rotation delta.

gameVersion.description: Unchanged API game version of the snapshot evaluated; equals expectedVersion on success.

rulesVersion.description: ScoringRules.version_key() for the stored match rules used in this preview.

PreviewScoreBreakdown.description: Sums of hypothetical score events from ScoringCoordinator.build_events_for_line, respecting previously scored hands and cluster entitlements. total must equal poker + edge + cluster. No points are awarded or persisted.

poker.description: Sum of new hand awards, including the approved ADR-013 formula: (category points + card values) multiplied by the card factor and new-edge factor. Uses the stored match's scoring configuration.

edge.description: Separate matching-edge awards: one point per newly created matching boundary, counted once.

cluster.description: Incremental color-cluster entitlement awards under the stored match rules; excludes bonuses already earned.

total.description: Total additional points this line would earn; not the player's accumulated score.

reason.description: Polkabow PlacementEnums rejection name. NO_REPEATED_RANK is the existing legacy name for any unranked/illegal hand, including an invalid straight or perpendicular run; it does not prohibit valid straights.

cell.description: The cell associated with the rejected placement, or the first staged cell when the rejection concerns the whole line.

tileIds.description: Distinct held tile IDs; current default deck size is six. Replacement draw and return follow Polkabow's stored tile-source state.

notification.example: No valid move available, now opponents turn

OnlinePrivateState.description: Caller-private projection: public board, own hand, turn, ledger and result; no bag, seed or opponent hand.

deadline.description: Always null; retained for older clients. Turns have no move deadline.
